method: Template-based synthetic records with new IDs and dates. Existing records are retained.
assumptions: 1000 sales were chosen for a small visible classroom refresh.
One monthly demand row is generated for every existing hospital and medicine pair.
Sales tax is 6 percent of net sales.
Previous hospital closing stock becomes the next opening stock.
Service level and stockout days use demonstration rules.
Hospital context and upstream trace references are reused from templates. Manufacturing and IoT events are not generated.
